title: AXI4 Master Source
text: Generate random access memory data, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Data type} sets Output data type; {Dimensions} sets the output data dimensions, {Enable sample packing (last signal dimension as channel)} sets the pack data on the last dimension, {Number of transfers} sets the number of write requests to send, {Initial address} sets the start address, {Initial delay}, {Data generation} sets the output generation type, {Counter init value} sets the initial counter value, {Variable name} sets the workspace variable name and {Sample time} sets the time interval of sampling. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type uint8 (default) | double | single | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | fixed point

params.name: Dimensions
params.values: Output data dimensions 1 | positive scalar | array

params.name: Enable sample packing (last signal dimension as channel)
params.values: Pack data on the last dimension of the signal off (default) | on

params.name: Number of transfers
params.values: Number of write requests to send 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Data generation
params.values: Output generation type counter (default) | random | ones | workspace

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Workspace variable name simOut (default) | any MATLAB-supported variable name

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Time interval of sampling 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector
